title: lmdb_store: get_raw error variant is IpfsError::WriteFailed not ReadFailed
description: lmdb_store.rs get_raw(): db.get() error is mapped to IpfsError::WriteFailed(e.to_string()) — should be IpfsError::ReadFailed. This is the wrong variant and makes error diagnosis harder. Compare rocks_store.rs which correctly uses IpfsError::ReadFailed for get_raw errors. This appears to be a copy-paste error from put_raw.
